name: Golden Sands Holiday Park
accommodation: Caravan holidays and short breaks, plus holiday homes for sale
dogs: Described as suitable for dog owners
confirmedFeatures: Clubhouse with licensed bar, games room, play area, skate park, sports pitch, small gym, cycle hire, laundry, 12-month season
overview: A beachfront park at Cresswell run by Northumbrian Leisure, overlooking the sand at the southern end of Druridge Bay. It offers caravan holidays and short breaks year-round, with a clubhouse bar, play area and small gym. The beach is right in front of the park.
surfTripFit: Year-round stays overlooking the beach mean you can watch the bay and paddle out with little effort.
